title: What is at 0°, 0°?
hook: Every map has a point where both zero lines cross. Go and look at it.

knows: that the equator and the prime meridian exist
doesNotKnow: how to read a position off a map by feel

misconception: Where the equator and prime meridian cross there must be something there, probably land.
objective: The learner can explain that latitude and longitude are a grid of angles measured from two chosen zero lines, and that the point (0, 0) is open ocean in the Gulf of Guinea.

claims.text: Latitude 0, longitude 0 is open ocean in the Gulf of Guinea, off West Africa.
claims.source: geoContains on the kit's 1:110m land and every country shape is false at (0, 0) (artifacts/scratch/w1-misc.mjs). Any atlas places it in the Gulf of Guinea. Resolution does not matter at this distance from any coast.

claims.text: On this map the nearest land to 0°, 0° is Ghana, about 570 km away.
claims.source: Nearest 1:110m country-outline vertex to (0, 0) by great-circle distance (R = 6,371.0088 km): Ghana at 4.71 N, 1.96 W (near Cape Three Points), 567 km, shown rounded to 10 km. Correction to the brief: the brief said about 625 km to Tema; Tema is not the nearest point of the coast. Vertex-based, so a slight overestimate; small islands are absent at 1:110m.

claims.text: Latitude counts degrees north or south of the equator; longitude counts degrees east or west of the prime meridian through Greenwich, London.
claims.source: Definition of geographic coordinates; prime meridian adopted at the International Meridian Conference, Washington, 1884.

claims.text: Quito (about 0.2°S) and Nairobi (about 1.3°S) sit close to latitude 0; Greenwich (about 51.5°N) sits on longitude 0.
claims.source: Gazetteer coordinates (e.g. GeoNames): Quito 0.18 S 78.47 W, Nairobi 1.29 S 36.82 E, Royal Observatory Greenwich 51.48 N 0.00. Builder could not open the gazetteer (network blocked). The lesson does not claim they are on the equator.

claims.text: Coordinates are a grid of angles laid over the Earth; the zero lines are choices, not features of the ground.
claims.source: The equator is fixed by the rotation axis; the prime meridian was chosen by convention (1884 conference). Framing sentence.

recall.question: Quito is almost exactly on the equator. Which of its coordinates is close to zero?
recall.why: The equator is latitude 0. Quito's longitude is about 78°W, so it is far from 0°, 0°, which lies in open sea in the Gulf of Guinea.
